policy.mapping_basis: test method names and bodies read at the audited commit, matched against contract clause text

clauses.clause: every baseline scene path is under the project root and contains no consumer product name
every required folder is under the project root, uses forward slashes with no trailing slash, is unique, and contains no consumer product name
running the folder scaffold twice reuses every existing folder and creates nothing new the second time
missing: a test that scaffolds into a disposable project root and asserts the second ScaffoldResult reports only reused folders; ProjectFolderScaffold currently targets the fixed Assets/_Project root, so the test needs an injectable root or a guarded real-project run

clauses.clause: Validate reports each missing required folder, baseline scene, and activation marker with a stable issue code and marks the folder and marker issues auto-fixable
missing: a test on IndieProjectValidator.ValidateIndieBaseline in a project without the scaffold asserting INIT_FOLDER_MISSING, INIT_SCENE_MISSING, and INIT_MARKER_MISSING with AutoFixable on the folder and marker issues

clauses.clause: the Editor and test assembly definitions reference no consumer runtime assembly
missing: a repository validation rule pinning Lingkyn.ProjectInitializer.Editor and its test asmdef references to Lingkyn.* and Unity-owned assemblies only

clauses.clause: a fresh VrBaselineConfig keeps continuous move disabled and every generated path constant stays under Assets/_Project with no consumer product name
rig repair configures the caster each NearFarInteractor references, raises a shorter cast distance, and never lowers a longer authored value
an interactor without a resolvable far caster produces a failed result whose diagnostic names the interactor
a rig with no interactors succeeds, configures nothing, and claims nothing
every by-name resolution reports through XrBaselineDiagnostics.Unresolved once per key, and the key set can be reset
clauses.note: The test proves the once-per-key helper; the wiring of every Editor call site through it was audited by reading the source at the audited commit and is listed in the xr-baseline changelog.

clauses.clause: Initialize Sandbox resets the key set first and ends with xr_baseline_initialized_with_unresolved when any key was reported
missing: a test that runs XrBaselineMenu.InitializeSandbox in a project without the XRI Starter Assets sample and expects the xr_baseline_initialized_with_unresolved warning; it needs a disposable scene and Build Settings guard

clauses.clause: GrabbableHoverVisual warns once per component when XR Interaction Toolkit, XRGrabInteractable, or isHovered cannot be resolved
missing: a test adding GrabbableHoverVisual to a GameObject without XRGrabInteractable and expecting exactly one warning across several Update calls

clauses.clause: headset tracking, grab, teleport, and comfort behavior of the generated Sandbox
missing: a Device Lab receipt bound to a full commit SHA; no package test can close this clause

summary.execution_note: RequiredFoldersAreUnderProjectRootAndUnique, the three rig repair tests, and UnresolvedMemberIsReportedOncePerKeyUntilReset have not executed in a Unity Editor; the map records authored coverage, not results.
